issuer: the Authority for Transport in Malta (Transport Malta)
note: Read 2026-10-30 on legislation.mt, the Laws of Malta, in the Motor Vehicles (Driving Licences) Regulations (S.L. 65.18, as amended to L.N. 298 of 2025). The Second Schedule sets 18 as the minimum age for category B, and only someone who has turned 18 may sit the theory test (reg. 18) or hold a standard learner's permit (reg. 20); new drivers who pass the test are granted a probationary driving licence for three years (reg. 38). So the full licence is kept from 21, 18 and the three years added (a reading). Reg. 44 gives a full category B licence an administrative validity of ten years (five past 70), granted against the Ninth Schedule's fee: a driving licence for ten years, €70 licence fee and €10 administrative charge, €80 in all (the probationary licence, €21 and €10, the €23.25 application and the €30.25 theory test aren't held). The identity card is the ids engine's. The agreements on exchanging licences (the Fourteenth Schedule) weren't read; no exchange list is held.
